Chidananda Panigrahy

📞 +91-9861058633 · ☎ sulupani@gmail.com 📍 Bengaluru, India

Personal Branding Statement

Cloud-savvy Java Tech Lead specializing in device integrations, automation, and scalable enterprise solutions across semiconductor, broadcast, and telecom domains.

🎯 Professional Summary

Tech Lead with 10+ years of experience in full-stack development, microservices, cloud architecture, and enterprise applications. Proven success across semiconductor, telecom, healthcare, broadcast media, banking, and IoT domains. Skilled in Core Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, AWS services, and WSO2 middleware. Known for leading cross-functional teams, driving automation, and delivering high-performance solutions.

🧰 Skills Snapshot

Category Tools & Technologies Programming Languages Java (Advanced), Python, SQL, PL/SQL Frameworks & Libraries Spring Boot, Hibernate, WSO2, MSF4J, REST API Cloud & DevOps AWS (Lambda, S3, SQS, RDS, SES), Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker Protocols TCP, HTTP, MQTT, Serial, gRPC Databases MongoDB, Oracle, MySQL Tools & IDEs Eclipse, IntelliJ, Pycharm, STS, Postman, SonarQube Design Patterns DAO, Singleton, Producer-Consumer, MVC Certified Expertise AWS Solutions Architect · Oracle Java SE & EE Certified Developer

💼 Professional Experience

Applied Materials – Tech Lead

Jan 2024 – Present

Led platform development for wafer inspection systems (Aviv, Enlight, Hawkeye, Vera).

Integrated device communication using gRPC and TCP protocols.

Simulated device APIs using protobuff files; performed calibration and image processing in Python.



Nokia – Software Development Engineer

Dec 2021 – Jan 2024

Maintained and enhanced Provisioning Gateway (PGW) for telecom products.

Delivered code contributions across multiple entities with consistent quality.

Tata Elxsi – Senior Engineer

Jan 2016 – Dec 2021

Led backend team for Programming Trading Portal (Multichoice, South Africa).

Developed and deployed microservices to AWS QA, UAT, and PROD environments.

Automated manual operations using WSO2; published REST APIs and integrated monitoring tools.

Accenture (UBS) – Software Engineer

Apr 2015 – Dec 2015

Engineered batch jobs for investment banking operations.

Implemented multithreaded processes using BlockingQueue and ExecutorService.

Designed PL/SQL packages for database operations.

🌐 Key Projects Across Domains

Domain Notable Projects Semiconductor OPWI Platform – Device integration and simulation using gRPC and Python Broadcast Trading Portal – Led 9-member team, microservices for ad inventory management IoT Smart Home & Water Monitoring – Protocol integrations, cloud storage via REST APIs Automation NOS Portugal – Migrated manual operations to automated microservices using WSO2 Banking UBS – Batch processing & decision logic with JDBC & PL/SQL

📈 Selected Achievements

Reduced API response time by 35% through refactoring and caching strategies.

Led deployment of 20+ microservices on AWS with 99.9% uptime.

Managed cross-functional teams across India and South Africa, improving sprint velocity by 20%.

Integrated Prometheus and Grafana for real-time API monitoring and visualization



➵ Education & Certifications

M.Tech in Computer Science, BPUT, 2010 – 7.8 CGPA

MCA, BPUT, 2007 – 6.99 CGPA

Certifications:

AWS Solutions Architect (2021)

Oracle Java SE & EE Developer Certified

🗣 Languages Known

English · Hindi · Oriya
